headline: Precision Built. Partner Driven.
body: MetaForge Industrial Systems delivers precision-engineered dock equipment, industrial doors, and material handling systems — installed right, serviced fast, and built to last. Founded by operators with over 30 years of industry experience, we hold the line on quality, speed, and accountability in every job. Headquartered in Texas and the Midwest, MetaForge is building the next generation of industrial infrastructure — one system at a time.

values.title: Extreme Ownership
values.description: We own our wins and our failures. If you're not happy, we'll make it right.

values.title: Long-Term Relationships
values.description: We're not here to make a quick buck. We'll be with you for the long haul.

values.title: Quality Under Pressure
values.description: If it's not built to last, it's not leaving our hands.

values.title: Speed Without Shortcuts
values.description: Fast is good. Sloppy is not. We move with purpose and quality.

values.title: Service That Shows Up
values.description: The phone gets answered. The trucks show up. On time. With pride.

values.title: People Over Titles
values.description: We respect real experience, not job descriptions.
